workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.body: This is where you switch workspaces: each has its own projects, members and tags. A new one is created right next to it — but let's start with the personal one.

tree-add.title: The project tree
tree-add.body: Projects live on the left. Press “+” to add the first one.

menu-project.title: Pick “Project”
menu-project.body: A group will come in handy later, once there are many projects.

project-create.title: Name the project
project-create.body: The name also decides the project address: /project/name. The address is assigned once — if it matters to you, set it by hand.

board-add.title: Add a board
board-add.body: Tasks live on boards, and a project may have several. Press “+” next to the project.

board-create.title: Name the board
board-create.body: Type a name and press Enter — the board appears in the tree with four columns.

board-open.title: Open the board
board-open.body: Click the board — the kanban opens.

task-create.title: Create a task
task-create.body: Press “Create task” in the «К работе» column, type a name and press Enter.

card-fields.title: Right on the card
card-fields.body: Priority, due date, tags and assignees are edited without opening the task — just click the icon on the card.

card-open.title: Open the task
card-open.body: Click the card — the full task form opens.

tm-due.title: Due date
tm-due.body: Set a due date — the calendar is also where repetition and reminders are configured.

tm-assignees.title: Assignees
tm-assignees.body: Choose who runs the task. While you are alone in the workspace — assign yourself.

tm-priority.title: Priority
tm-priority.body: Priority colours the dot on the card, and the board can be sorted by it.

tm-tags.title: Tags
tm-tags.body: A tag is created right here. The board can group into columns by tags — that is the main way to arrange tasks your own way.

tm-description.title: Description
tm-description.body: Describe the task: Markdown, attachments and {'@'} mentions are supported.

tm-tabs.title: Comments, subtasks, relations
tm-tabs.body: The same place holds the discussion, the subtask tree, relations to other tasks and the full change history.

tm-save.title: Save the task
tm-save.body: Press “Save” — the modal closes and the changes show up on the card.

board-tools.title: Board views and tools
board-tools.body: On the left — kanban, list, calendar and Gantt: the same tasks in different cuts. In the middle — search across the whole workspace, on the right — tags, milestones and the archive.

board-composer.title: Grouping, sorting, filters
board-composer.body: The “+” on this bar adds grouping (including by tag), sorting and filters, and on the right is the card layout setting.

dnd-card.title: Drag the card
dnd-card.body: A task moves between columns by dragging — that is how its status changes on the board. Drag the card into «В процессе».

group-add.title: Projects group up too
group-add.body: Once there are many projects, they go into groups. Press “+” above the tree once more.

menu-group.title: Pick “Group”
menu-group.body: Now the second menu item comes in handy.

group-created.title: The group is created
group-created.body: It is called “Group” — double-click the name to rename it.

dnd-project.title: Drag the project into the group
dnd-project.body: The project tree drags the same way: pick a project up and drop it into a group.

nav-sections.title: Notes, documents, reminders
nav-sections.body: Besides boards, a workspace holds notes, collaborative documents and reminders.

nav-footer.title: Settings and notifications
nav-footer.body: At the bottom — your profile and settings, next to them the bell with notifications.

done.title: All set
done.body: That is everything you need to start. The guide can be restarted from the same place, at the bottom of the sidebar.
